anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Broad, smooth convex arc forming the anterior cranial boundary with a large radius relative to the transverse head width.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, conical extension with a pixel length roughly equal to its width at the base of the melon.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Highly obtuse transition angle of approximately 155 degrees visible at the pixel boundary where the melon meets the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: The subject is a stylized, monochromatic cyan-colored 3D mesh model with uniform polygonal surfaces and artificial specular lighting.
